title: Tower Blocks
description: Build the tallest tower by dropping the blocks perfectly.
about:
Tower Blocks is a browser game where you drop each moving block onto the tower. Keep the stack aligned as it grows.

Start a round in your browser and use the controls below to play.
howToPlay: Drop each moving block onto the tower. Keep the stack aligned as it grows.
tips: Use click / tap / space to drop a block or restart.
Try another round to practice the timing and strategy.

faq.question: How do I play Tower Blocks?
faq.answer: Drop each moving block onto the tower. Keep the stack aligned as it grows.

faq.question: Can I play Tower Blocks in a browser?
faq.answer: Yes. Open the game page and play without installing an app.
